commit_message: feat(linkedin): ship autonomous Git-to-LinkedIn AI Agent with Gemini 3.6 Flash and media publishing
post_content:
I got tired of context-switching to post manual build logs after pushing code, so I built an autonomous AI agent that converts my Git commits directly into published LinkedIn posts.

Meet the latest addition to AURA-OS: a fully automated Git-to-LinkedIn pipeline powered by Gemini.

Here is what just shipped in commit `320863a`:

⚡ **Gemini Flash Intelligence**: Integrated `linkedin_agent.py` to parse Git diffs, commit metadata, and project memory to write authentic, context-aware engineering updates.
🔐 **OAuth 2.0 & Media Pipeline**: Engineered a custom authentication layer (`linkedin_auth.py`) paired with dynamic media publishing to upload visual assets alongside posts.
🔄 **Git Hook & CI/CD Integration**: Implemented auto-executing local Git hooks and GitHub Actions (`linkedin_autopost.yml`) for seamless, zero-friction automated publishing.
🧠 **Stateful Agent Memory**: Connected local context logs (`task_log.json`) to keep the agent aware of project evolution over time.

Engineering Takeaway: Building reliable developer tools with LLMs requires focusing heavily on the surrounding infrastructure—auth persistence, robust error handling, and state tracking are what turn a basic API call into a truly autonomous workflow.

commit_message: feat(linkedin): ship autonomous Git-to-LinkedIn AI Agent with Gemini 3.6 Flash and media publishing
post_content:
What if pushing code to your repository automatically analyzed your diffs, generated full visual architecture reveals, and published detailed tech breakdowns to LinkedIn with zero human intervention?

Today, I shipped the autonomous Git-to-LinkedIn AI Agent pipeline for AURA-OS! 🚀

Here is what went into this commit:

⚡ Gemini 3.6 Flash Engine: Integrated Google's fast inference model to parse Git diffs, task logs, and deep context (`context.json`) into clear, developer-focused technical narratives.
🖼️ Autonomous Visual & Media Pipeline: Added full media-upload capabilities (`linkedin_agent.py`) to publish high-res architecture diagrams, code diffs, and banners directly alongside text posts.
🔐 Secure OAuth 2.0 & CI/CD Hooks: Built auto-refresh token handling and hooked the agent directly into Git workflows and GitHub Actions (`linkedin_autopost.yml`) for instant trigger-on-push execution.
🧠 Context & Memory Logging: Implemented execution tracking (`task_log.json`) so the agent maintains state, prevents duplicate posts, and stays context-aware over time.

Engineering Takeaway:
Developer automation shouldn't just run tests—it should bridge the gap between building code and sharing knowledge. By combining diff analysis, vision LLMs, and background execution hooks, your codebase can literally speak for itself.
